new_entities.name: PortfolioReviewRecord
new_entities.description: Aggregate root for one periodic suitability review cycle. Created at PH-071 when a review is scheduled and closed at PH-076 when the post-review report is dispatched. Tracks review status, meeting details, linked suitability assessment, rebalancing recommendation, and next review date.

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation: globally unique, immutable

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation: FK to Customer (ENT-001, CAP-001); not null

fields.name: advisor_id
fields.validation: FK to Wealth Advisor identity (IAM); not null

fields.name: advisor_fca_register_ref
fields.validation: FCA Financial Services Register reference; not null for all regulated actions

fields.name: review_type
fields.validation: annual | material_change_triggered | ad_hoc_client_request

fields.name: scheduled_at
fields.validation: not null

fields.name: meeting_confirmed_at
fields.validation: nullable — null until client confirms

fields.name: status
fields.validation: scheduled | in_progress | suitability_pending | awaiting_client_instruction | execution_in_progress | reporting | completed | overdue | cancelled

fields.name: suitability_assessment_id
fields.validation: FK to SuitabilityAssessment (ENT-047); nullable until PH-072 starts

fields.name: rebalancing_recommendation_id
fields.validation: FK to RebalancingRecommendation (ENT-048); nullable until PH-073

fields.name: investment_instruction_id
fields.validation: FK to InvestmentInstruction (ENT-049); nullable until PH-074

fields.name: consumer_duty_evidence_id
fields.validation: FK to ConsumerDutyEvidenceRecord (ENT-051); nullable until PH-076

fields.name: prior_review_id
fields.validation: FK to prior PortfolioReviewRecord; nullable for first review

fields.name: next_review_date
fields.validation: set at PH-076; must be within 12 months of review_completed_at per COBS 9A

fields.name: review_completed_at
fields.validation: nullable — set at PH-076

fields.name: contact_attempts
fields.validation: 0..N; incremented on each scheduling communication to client

fields.name: escalated_at
fields.validation: nullable — set if contact_attempts >= 3

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation: not null; updated on each status transition

relationships.note: One PortfolioReviewRecord has one SuitabilityAssessment per review cycle
One PortfolioReviewRecord has one InvestmentInstruction capturing the client's decision
Multiple snapshots per review: pre-review and post-rebalancing
One Consumer Duty evidence record per review cycle
CAP-001 entity; referenced by client_id; not owned by SVC-016

design_decisions.decision: PortfolioReviewRecord is the aggregate root for the entire review lifecycle. All other JRN-015 entities are linked through it.
design_decisions.rationale: Provides a single audit entry point for the MiFID II suitability review cycle. Simplifies compliance querying: 'show all completed reviews for client X in the last 5 years' maps to a single entity.

new_entities.name: SuitabilityAssessment
new_entities.description: Records the full MiFID II suitability assessment for one review cycle: questionnaire responses, risk profile scoring, sustainability preferences, suitability gap analysis, advisor notes, and the final suitability report. The suitability report PDF is stored as a reference (not inline). Owned by SVC-016 (Wealth Management). A copy of the suitability record reference is published to SVC-014 (CAP-005) via async event for the central compliance audit trail.

fields.name: assessment_id
fields.validation: globally unique, immutable

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation: FK to PortfolioReviewRecord (ENT-046); not null

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation: FK to Customer (ENT-001, CAP-001); not null

fields.name: questionnaire_version
fields.validation: version identifier of the suitability questionnaire template; not null

fields.name: questionnaire_responses
fields.validation: complete set of scored questionnaire answers; not null; schema validated against questionnaire_version

fields.name: prior_risk_profile_score
fields.validation: 1..10; copied from prior SuitabilityAssessment at review start

fields.name: updated_risk_profile_score
fields.validation: 1..10; computed from questionnaire_responses

computed_from.logic: Risk scoring model: weighted sum of questionnaire_responses[loss_tolerance], questionnaire_responses[investment_horizon], questionnaire_responses[investment_knowledge], questionnaire_responses[financial_situation_stability]. Score band: 1-3 Cautious, 4-6 Moderate, 7-8 Growth, 9-10 Aggressive.

fields.name: risk_profile_changed
fields.validation: true if updated_risk_profile_score != prior_risk_profile_score by >= 2 bands

fields.name: sustainability_preferences
fields.validation: captures ESG preference flags per FCA SDR label categories; nullable if client has no preference

fields.name: suitability_gap_flags
fields.validation: list of instruments in current mandate that are no longer suitable given the updated risk profile; may be empty

fields.name: head_of_suitability_required
fields.validation: true if risk_profile_changed = true OR any suitability_gap_flags present for a restricted investment

fields.name: head_of_suitability_signoff_ref
fields.validation: nullable; required if head_of_suitability_required = true before status = issued

fields.name: head_of_suitability_signoff_notes
fields.validation: nullable; internal compliance record only; never projected to client

fields.name: advisor_notes
fields.validation: advisor-only notes; not included in client-facing suitability report

fields.name: recommendation_rationale_client
fields.validation: consumer-facing rationale for the rebalancing recommendation; included in suitability report

fields.name: ex_ante_costs_charges
fields.validation: MiFID II standardised costs and charges disclosure; not null before status = issued

fields.name: ex_post_costs_charges
fields.validation: MiFID II annual ex-post disclosure; not null

fields.name: suitability_report_document_ref
fields.validation: reference to PDF document; not null when status = issued

fields.name: client_acknowledged_at
fields.validation: nullable; set when client acknowledges the suitability report in the portal

fields.name: client_acknowledgement_ip
fields.validation: last 4 octets retained for audit; full IP stored in WORM audit trail only

fields.name: status
fields.validation: in_progress | gap_analysis_complete | pending_hofs_signoff | report_generated | issued | acknowledged | archived

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable

fields.name: issued_at
fields.validation: nullable; set when suitability report is issued to client

relationships.note: Each SuitabilityAssessment belongs to one PortfolioReviewRecord
The suitability assessment provides the basis for the rebalancing recommendation

design_decisions.decision: SuitabilityAssessment is owned by SVC-016. SVC-014 (CAP-005) stores only a lightweight SuitabilityRecord reference (assessment_id, review_id, client_id, issued_at, status) for compliance audit queries. It does not hold the full questionnaire data.
design_decisions.rationale: Full questionnaire responses and advisor notes are operationally sensitive wealth management data. SVC-014's compliance audit record only needs the evidence that a compliant review was conducted and issued — not the full advisory content.

design_decisions.decision: head_of_suitability_signoff_notes is encrypted at rest and never projected to the client or included in the suitability report.
design_decisions.rationale: Internal compliance sign-off notes may contain risk assessments or escalation rationale that is privileged under FSMA s348. Excluded from all client-facing projections.

new_entities.name: RebalancingRecommendation
new_entities.description: Captures the Wealth Advisor's investment rebalancing recommendation for one review cycle: proposed trade list, target allocation, rationale, ex-ante costs, and the SDR label set. Created at PH-073. Linked to the SuitabilityAssessment as the basis document. May be declined by the client (client_decision = declined).

fields.name: recommendation_id
fields.validation: globally unique, immutable

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation: FK to PortfolioReviewRecord (ENT-046); not null

fields.name: assessment_id
fields.validation: FK to SuitabilityAssessment (ENT-047); not null

fields.name: proposed_trades
fields.validation: array of {instrument_id, instrument_name, action: buy|sell|hold, amount_gbp, target_weight_pct, sddr_label: string|null}; not null; min 1 item if any rebalancing proposed

fields.name: target_allocation
fields.validation: asset class percentages summing to 100; validated by system

fields.name: current_allocation
fields.validation: asset class percentages at time of recommendation; not null

fields.name: performance_vs_benchmark
fields.validation: 1-year, 3-year portfolio return vs benchmark index; includes attribution summary

fields.name: ex_post_costs_charges
fields.validation: MiFID II COBS 9A ex-post total costs for prior 12 months

fields.name: ex_ante_costs_charges
fields.validation: MiFID II COBS 9A ex-ante costs for proposed portfolio

fields.name: model_weights
fields.validation: internal optimiser weights; not projected to client

fields.name: investment_committee_override
fields.validation: true if IC manual override applied

fields.name: investment_committee_override_notes
fields.validation: nullable; internal only

fields.name: client_decision
fields.validation: pending | approved | declined | partial_approved

fields.name: client_decision_at
fields.validation: nullable; set when client gives instruction

fields.name: client_decline_reason
fields.validation: nullable; required if client_decision = declined; COBS 9A requires documentation of client override

fields.name: cash_balance_included
fields.validation: true if ALT-002 cross-capability account data was retrieved and included in recommendation

fields.name: cash_balance_snapshot_gbp
fields.validation: nullable; populated from CAP-001 event response if ALT-002; used for liquidity buffer assessment

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable

fields.name: updated_at
fields.validation: not null

design_decisions.decision: model_weights and investment_committee_override_notes are encrypted and excluded from all client projections.
design_decisions.rationale: Internal optimiser model weights are commercially sensitive intellectual property. IC override notes may contain market-sensitive information.

design_decisions.decision: cash_balance_snapshot_gbp is a locally cached value from CAP-001, populated only in ALT-002. SVC-016 does not maintain a live balance — it uses the point-in-time snapshot received from the async event.
design_decisions.rationale: SVC-016 must not hold a live replica of CAP-001 Account data. The snapshot is explicitly timestamped and used only for the liquidity buffer calculation in the review session.

new_entities.name: InvestmentInstruction
new_entities.description: Records the client's formal investment instruction for the review cycle: the client's decision (proceed, decline, partial), the individual trade orders submitted to the custody platform, and execution outcomes. Created at PH-074. One instruction per review cycle.

fields.name: instruction_id
fields.validation: globally unique, immutable

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation: FK to PortfolioReviewRecord (ENT-046); not null

fields.name: recommendation_id
fields.validation: FK to RebalancingRecommendation (ENT-048); not null

fields.name: instruction_type
fields.validation: proceed_full | proceed_partial | decline

fields.name: instructions_given_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable audit record

fields.name: orders
fields.validation: array of {order_id: UUID, instrument_id: string, action: buy|sell, amount_gbp: decimal, status: pending|submitted|confirmed|failed|cancelled, custody_order_ref: string|null, submitted_at: datetime|null, confirmed_at: datetime|null, fail_reason: string|null}; not null if instruction_type != decline

fields.name: custody_platform
fields.validation: FNZ | SEI | other

fields.name: mifid_transaction_refs
fields.validation: array of UTI strings; one per executed order; required by MiFID II transaction reporting

fields.name: execution_status
fields.validation: not_started | in_progress | fully_executed | partially_executed | failed | not_required (if instruction_type=decline)

fields.name: execution_completed_at
fields.validation: nullable; set when all orders reach terminal state

fields.name: partial_execution_notes
fields.validation: nullable; required if execution_status = partially_executed (EXC-002)

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable

relationships.note: Post-execution snapshot taken after all orders confirmed

design_decisions.decision: Trade orders are modelled as a JSON array within InvestmentInstruction rather than as a separate Orders entity.
design_decisions.rationale: Rebalancing orders are always processed as a batch (never individually from an instruction perspective). Embedding as a JSON array simplifies the aggregate and avoids a spurious entity. The order array is small (typically 5-20 items per rebalancing).

new_entities.name: PortfolioSnapshot
new_entities.description: An immutable point-in-time record of the client's portfolio holdings, market values, asset allocation, and performance metrics. Created at PH-071 (pre-review baseline) and at PH-076 (post-rebalancing). Provides the basis for the performance review presentation and the post-review report. May also be created ad hoc for intra-review recalculation.

fields.name: snapshot_id
fields.validation: globally unique, immutable

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation: FK to Customer (ENT-001, CAP-001); not null

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation: FK to PortfolioReviewRecord (ENT-046); not null

fields.name: snapshot_type
fields.validation: pre_review | post_rebalancing | intra_review

fields.name: snapshot_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable

fields.name: total_market_value_gbp
fields.validation: non-negative; sum of all position market values converted to GBP

computed_from.logic: SUM(positions[*].market_value_gbp) where market_value_gbp = position_quantity * closing_price * fx_rate_to_gbp

fields.name: positions
fields.validation: array of {instrument_id: string, instrument_name: string, isin: string, asset_class: enum, market_value_gbp: decimal, position_quantity: decimal, closing_price: decimal, currency: string, fx_rate_to_gbp: decimal, sddr_label: string|null, weight_pct: decimal}

fields.name: asset_allocation
fields.validation: asset class percentages summing to 100; computed from positions

fields.name: performance_1yr_pct
fields.validation: nullable on first snapshot; computed from current vs 12-month-prior snapshot

fields.name: performance_3yr_pct
fields.validation: nullable if portfolio < 3 years old

fields.name: benchmark_return_1yr_pct
fields.validation: nullable; ARC/WMA benchmark return for the client's risk profile band

fields.name: benchmark_id
fields.validation: ARC index identifier per risk profile (e.g. ARC_STERLING_MODERATE_GROWTH)

fields.name: ex_post_total_costs_pct
fields.validation: MiFID II total charges expressed as a percentage of AUM for the period; not null when snapshot_type = pre_review

fields.name: cash_balance_gbp
fields.validation: nullable; populated from ALT-002 cross-capability event if included in holistic view

relationships.note: Post-rebalancing snapshot is linked from the InvestmentInstruction

design_decisions.decision: PortfolioSnapshot is immutable once created. A new snapshot is always created; existing snapshots are never updated.
design_decisions.rationale: Regulatory audit requirement: the performance figures presented to the client during the review meeting must be identical to the figures stored in the compliance record. Mutable snapshots would allow retrospective alteration of regulatory evidence.

new_entities.name: ConsumerDutyEvidenceRecord
new_entities.description: Records the bank's annual Consumer Duty fair value evidence for one client review cycle. Documents the service activities delivered for the advisory/management fee charged, the fair value assessment outcome, and any remediation actions. Required by FCA Consumer Duty (PS22/9). Created at PH-076. Published to CAP-005 for central compliance tracking.

fields.name: evidence_id
fields.validation: globally unique, immutable

fields.name: review_id
fields.validation: FK to PortfolioReviewRecord (ENT-046); not null

fields.name: client_id
fields.validation: FK to Customer (ENT-001, CAP-001); not null

fields.name: period_start
fields.validation: start of the annual service period; not null

fields.name: period_end
fields.validation: end of the annual service period; not null

fields.name: total_fee_charged_gbp
fields.validation: total advisory/management fee charged in the period; not null

fields.name: fee_basis_pct
fields.validation: fee as a percentage of average AUM in the period

fields.name: average_aum_gbp
fields.validation: average AUM over the period; not null

fields.name: service_activities_delivered
fields.validation: list of service activities delivered (review meetings, ad hoc calls, reports, etc.); not null; min 1 item

fields.name: service_activities_summary
fields.validation: consumer-facing summary of service activities for the annual statement; not null

fields.name: fair_value_assessment_score
fields.validation: fair_value_met | fair_value_borderline | fair_value_gap; internal only; encrypted at rest

fields.name: fair_value_assessment_notes
fields.validation: internal compliance notes; not projected to client

fields.name: remediation_required
fields.validation: true if fair_value_assessment_score = fair_value_gap

fields.name: remediation_plan_ref
fields.validation: nullable; reference to remediation plan document if remediation_required = true

fields.name: annual_statement_dispatched_at
fields.validation: nullable; set when annual service statement dispatched to client

fields.name: compliance_submitted_at
fields.validation: nullable; set when ConsumerDutyEvidenceCompleted event published to CAP-005

fields.name: created_at
fields.validation: not null; immutable

design_decisions.decision: fair_value_assessment_score and fair_value_assessment_notes are encrypted at rest and excluded from all client-facing projections.
design_decisions.rationale: Internal fair value assessment scores are commercially sensitive and legally privileged compliance assessments. Disclosing borderline or gap scores to clients before remediation could trigger premature complaints or regulatory notifications. The client receives only the service_activities_summary.

referenced_existing_entities.usage: JRN-015: Referenced by client_id on ENT-046, ENT-047, ENT-050, ENT-051. SVC-016 holds only the UUID reference — no local copy of Customer fields. In ALT-002, SVC-016 requests a point-in-time account summary from SVC-001 via async event.
JRN-015: SVC-016 references the existing KYC clearance status for the HNW client to confirm ongoing relationship is compliant before proceeding with the review. KYC record is not modified by JRN-015.
